title: 3D model viewer
description: Open your own STL or OpenSCAD file to view, section and measure it in the browser, with Customizer parameters as controls. Nothing is uploaded.
notes: The viewer works as it does for the site's other models: right-drag to orbit about the point under the cursor, click edges and corners to measure them, use the cube at the top right for standard views, and switch on a section to look inside.
